title: We sold lamps we do not have
voice: Lamp Week started Monday. The Ember Table Lamp (LH-LAMP-03) had three units left and we sold forty of them overnight. Customer care is sending apology emails and a 15% voucher to every one of those customers, and our warehouse in New Jersey is being asked why their count was wrong when it was not.

This is the second flash sale where the stock number on the site and the stock on the shelf disagree. Finance has stopped trusting the inventory report; they now ask the warehouse for a manual count before every promotion.
I need to know how this happens, how many orders are affected right now, and what stops it before Black Friday. I do not need a rewrite of the inventory system.

impact.trust: Finance requests a manual count before every promotion (≈4 h of warehouse time each)

constraints: Lamp Week continues; the site stays up
Fixes ship behind a feature flag
deadline: Root cause and affected-order list by end of day; prevention proposal before Black Friday (31 Oct)
